relations: The tossing hand releases each coin upward, initiating its parabolic ascent.
The catching hand positions below the falling coins, ready to intercept each descent.
As a coin falls into the waiting hand, the fingers close to secure it.
This tossing and catching sequence repeats for multiple coins in continuous motion.
caption: A person skillfully tosses several coins in the air, catching them one by one.
